newsitem.title: INDIA: Gunmen kill four bus passengers in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill four bus passengers in Kashmir.

text.p: Four people were killed on Thursday when unidentified gunmen opened fire on a bus in India's troubled state of Jammu and Kashmir, police said.

The gunmen, suspected to be Moslem militants, fired indiscriminately on the moving bus near Kashmir's "apple town" of Sopore, 50 km (30 miles) north of the state's summer capital of Srinagar, police said.
More than 20,000 people have died in seven years of a separatist uprising in Kashmir, mainly Hindu India's only Moslem majority region.
On Tuesday, unidentified militants exploded a bomb in a mosque in Srinagar which killed four Moslem worshipers waiting to end their day-long Ramadan fast.
More than a dozen militant groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Kashmir.
